items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote:
Mit dem Einspruch können Sie diesen Bescheid anfechten, und zwar binnen eines Monats ab
Bekanntgabe.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 28.07.2026, sent by ordinary post by a tax office, so it counts as delivered (Bekanntgabefiktion) on the 4th day after posting under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO: 28.07.2026 + 4 days = Sat 01.08.2026. Since that falls on a Saturday, delivery shifts to the next business day, Mon 03.08.2026 (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO). The one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) starts the day after deemed delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO) and ends one month later on the day with the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Thu 03.09.2026. That day is a normal working day in Rheinland-Pfalz (not a weekend or public holiday), so no further shift applies.
